# Lab 12.4: Boosted Trees, Random Forest & DNN

## What We Are Going to Do
Train a boosted tree, a random forest and a deep neural network on the same data and compare their metrics.

## Steps

1. **[SQL] Create a shared training view.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW lab12.v_income AS
SELECT age, workclass, education, marital_status, occupation, hours_per_week, sex, income_bracket
FROM `bigquery-public-data.ml_datasets.census_adult_income`;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[SQL] Boosted tree (XGBoost).**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE OR REPLACE MODEL lab12.income_bt
OPTIONS (model_type = 'BOOSTED_TREE_CLASSIFIER', input_label_cols = ['income_bracket'],
         max_iterations = 50, max_tree_depth = 6, enable_global_explain = TRUE)
AS SELECT * FROM lab12.v_income;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[SQL] Random forest.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE OR REPLACE MODEL lab12.income_rf
OPTIONS (model_type = 'RANDOM_FOREST_CLASSIFIER', input_label_cols = ['income_bracket'], num_parallel_tree = 50)
AS SELECT * FROM lab12.v_income;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **[CLI] DNN from the CLI.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq query --use_legacy_sql=false '
CREATE OR REPLACE MODEL lab12.income_dnn
OPTIONS (model_type = "DNN_CLASSIFIER", input_label_cols = ["income_bracket"],
         hidden_units = [64, 32], max_iterations = 20)
AS SELECT * FROM lab12.v_income'</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **[SQL] Compare.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT 'logistic' AS m, roc_auc, accuracy FROM ML.EVALUATE(MODEL lab12.income_lr) UNION ALL
SELECT 'boosted', roc_auc, accuracy FROM ML.EVALUATE(MODEL lab12.income_bt) UNION ALL
SELECT 'forest', roc_auc, accuracy FROM ML.EVALUATE(MODEL lab12.income_rf) UNION ALL
SELECT 'dnn', roc_auc, accuracy FROM ML.EVALUATE(MODEL lab12.income_dnn)
ORDER BY roc_auc DESC;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


6. **[Console] Compare training time.** Open each model's **Details → Training** and note the duration.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Boosted tree | Usually the best AUC on tabular data |
| Random forest | Close, more robust to noise |
| DNN | Slower to train, needs tuning |
| Choice | Balance accuracy, speed and explainability |
